lines.2: It was the academy's foundation day, so classes were off, but many students had come voluntarily to prepare for the sports and martial arts festival.
lines.3: The drama club was no exception.
lines.4: I spotted Konoe at the school gate that morning.
lines.7: 「If I hadn't shown up, you and Otome would've killed me.」
lines.8: Contractor vehicles kept arriving at the gate one after another.
lines.10: 「No wonder dust builds up around the gate.」
lines.11: 「They say this rush of vehicles will last until this evening.」
lines.12: 「So I'm starting the gate cleaning today.」
lines.13: 「The surrounding walls are dirty too... We'll just have to chip away at those.」
lines.17: Was that the secret behind her constant intensity?
lines.18: 「You really do still love that bread.」
lines.19: 「You keep saying 'still' over and over... I'm just me.」
lines.21: 「Though it looks like you've turned into a spineless coward.」
lines.24: I brushed Konoe off and headed to the drama-club room.
lines.25: We held a meeting with everyone who'd shown up.
lines.26: 「The costumes are here, so let's all try them on.」
lines.27: We pulled vinyl-wrapped outfits from the boxes I'd carried yesterday.
lines.29: 「Yes. We happened to have one extra outfit for a guy.」
lines.31: 「It's rented, so don't get it dirty.」
lines.32: This black outfit was... a formal suit?
lines.34: At the president's command, everyone moved briskly.
lines.36: I, the outsider helping out, stood there confused.
lines.38: Konoe shoved me out of the classroom.
lines.39: Then the door slammed shut behind me.
lines.40: 「...She doesn't have to be so rough.」
lines.41: Nothing for it. I guess I'll change next door for now.
lines.42: I pulled the clothes from the plastic bag.
lines.45: 「You've seen that look in Western movies, right? Picture a butler.」
lines.48: 「Oh... I feel like my cool factor went up.」
lines.49: Still dressed up, I returned to the club room.
lines.50: 「Looks like the boys are done changing too.」
lines.52: Every girl was wearing a maid uniform!!!
lines.55: If I said it suited her perfectly, she'd definitely get angry.
